scope: Current productAnalytics Host, live collection policy, approved environment/identity assembly and ordinary telemetry consumer

paired.comparison: Actual Source and Native mounted service with controlled OS, account identity and telemetry ports. Includes actual Source metadata collector and query wrapper, Native collector, schema rejection and reversible settings ownership.

verification.native: Initial targeted run: 14 passed and 2 test-fixture failures. After fixing double volatile parsing and raw Remote marker inspection, both affected tests passed in native2. Remaining passing cases cover disposal/sampling abort, live policy during identity lookup, cached sample rejection, product telemetry HTTP and query/collector consumers.
verification.source: 15 passed in collection.host.spec.ts, including actual Source HTTP collector export.
verification.actual_native_http: Registry-resolved analytics -> productTelemetry -> otel ordinary reporter -> isolated actual HTTP collector; asserts selected identity/environment/event fields, x-channel and shutdown flush.
verification.scope_reason: Owning Host policy, Remote metadata, concurrent cached environment/fresh account identity, disposal, and direct ordinary-channel consumer chain.

behavior: Disabled intake returns before environment and identity lookup. Static environment promise is shared and cached; identity is read afresh for each intake. Policy is checked again after asynchronous lookup.
Remote enabled/report/watchPolicy are bound on the canonical service. Live loader updates notify subscribers; abort and disposal remove subscription listeners.

Only selected environment and device/user identity fields are merged with the typed event; fixed missing reasons are sorted into one scalar; appVersion is added when defined. Compaction start emits manual/auto events.
Disposal closes intake, aborts and awaits environment sampling, and reverses optional settings configuration. Product telemetry retains its independent channel ownership.
limitations: Source web-app/Desktop composition rows and official client bundle promotion remain pending C9. Ordinary Web does not mount productAnalytics by default.

The preliminary paired run was excluded because both fixtures rejected duplicated volatile configuration during mount; qualification-exclusion.json records that failure and replacement. Only paired2 establishes mounted Host comparisons.
No new complete release, Portable/browser or Windows 7 acceptance is claimed. Default macOS sampling remains incomplete as recorded in analytics-os-checks.json.

cleanup.retained: Final raw paired observations, initial fixture failure diagnostics and exclusion, commands/input hashes/XML/logs, compact observations and Source Vitest JSON; shared Source/toolchains retained through C9.
